metric_notes.mrr: MRR is computed on the top-5 slice (MRR@5); mean_reciprocal_rank takes no k, so scoring the full pool would silently yield MRR@20.
metric_notes.support_proxy: lexical_support_score and supported_claim_fraction are deterministic lexical proxies, not semantic faithfulness measurements.
metric_notes.oracle: oracle_evidence_generation receives ground-truth evidence directly; its retrieval metrics are perfect by construction and must never be compared against retrieval configurations.
